zh: u 和 w 的共同朋友数，恰好等于路径 u − v − w 的条数（v 是中间人）。每人至多 15 个朋友，所以枚举“朋友的朋友”很便宜。
对每个 u 枚举所有二跳路径，给既不是 u 也不是 u 的朋友的 w 计数；有正分候选时取分数最高、再取编号最小者。没有正分候选时，任意非朋友的共同数都是 0，取最小的非朋友编号即可。
用邻接表存图；处理 u 时先标记 u 的朋友，再统计二跳次数并记下被触及的节点，选完后只清零这些节点。回退扫描从 0 开始跳过 u 和朋友，最多看 17 个编号；扫到 n 仍没有就输出 -1。
en: The number of mutual friends of u and w is exactly the number of paths u - v - w through a middle person v. Everyone has at most 15 friends, so enumerating friends of friends is cheap.

For each u, walk every two-hop path and count the endpoints w that are neither u nor a friend of u; if there is a positive-score candidate, take the highest score and then the smallest ID. If there is none, every non-friend has 0 mutual friends, so take the smallest non-friend ID.

Store the graph as adjacency lists. For u, mark its friends, count two-hop hits while remembering which nodes were touched, choose the best, and reset only those nodes. The fallback scan starts at 0 and skips u and its friends, checking at most 17 IDs; if it reaches n, print -1.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Enumerate the friends of each person's friends to count two-hop occurrences, excluding the person and their direct friends; if there is no candidate with a positive score, scan for the smallest ID not in the set formed by the person and their friends.

## Proof of correctness

Each path u-v-w corresponds to exactly one mutual friend v, and the absence of multi-edges guarantees that the count equals the number of mutual friends. Every positive-score candidate appears, so choosing by score and then by ID is exact; a non-friend that never appears has 0 mutual friends and can only be optimal when there is no positive-score candidate, in which case the smallest such ID is chosen directly.

## Complexity

O(n*15^2) time and O(n+m) space; the zero-score fallback checks at most 17 IDs.
